claims.claim_text: Characterization of Iran as violating the human rights of its population.
U.S. intervention and imperialism have contributed to political turmoil in Honduras and Nicaragua.
Bashar Assad, the dictator of Syria, has murdered hundreds of thousands of his own people and created millions of refugees.
Opposition to the continued existence of the U.S. Naval Base at Guantánamo Bay.
Characterization of Iran as the leading state sponsor of terrorism.
Thousands have been slaughtered for their faith in the Middle East and Africa, which the State Department has belatedly labeled genocide.
